status: Frozen for G0 (rules and code). The frozen evaluation SET does not exist yet: it needs T1 phone captures (auto-training-plan.md section 3.2). Any change to this file or to lightly_auto/rubric.py or lightly_auto/stats.py needs a version bump and a new PROTOCOL.lock (python freeze_protocol.py).

sources.targets: docs/m1/spec.md section 1.1 (per-scene Must preserve / Must correct)

analysis_resolution.resample: PIL LANCZOS from the oriented 8-bit sRGB source
analysis_resolution.why: 2048 px is the deployment preview proxy (lut-feasibility.md section 6.1). All rubric statistics are global or region means, so a fixed proxy keeps metrics comparable across source sizes and bounds cost. The plan's 'full deployment resolution' is read as the proxy the app renders, not the export size.

model_input: lightly_auto preprocess = ia3dlut.prepare_256_antialiased(proxy): whole frame, aspect ignored, bilinear antialiased resize to 256x256, sRGB-encoded [0,1]
lut_application: exact-grid trilinear (ia3dlut.apply_lut_reference with binsize numerator 1.0), output rounded as ia3dlut.to_uint8

face_detector.pinning: The faces.json sha256 is recorded in every run summary. A new detector version is a protocol change.

tolerances.why_new_clipping_pp: spec says 'no new clipping'. 0.5 percentage points of pixels absorbs 8-bit rounding at the clip thresholds (<=1, >=254) while still failing every crush seen in M1 (+3.5 to +7.4 pp).

skin.applies_to: every image with at least one detected face and >= 50 skin-mask pixels, whatever its class
skin.not_automated: Correction of face under-exposure on images NOT labelled face_underexposed is judged in the preference study. No L* threshold is used to infer under-exposure, because any fixed L* threshold would label deep skin tones as under-exposed.

portrait.note: Portraits are gated by the skin criteria. A portrait with no usable face mask is unscorable.

sunset.not_automated: Crushed-foreground correction needs a foreground mask; preference study only in v1.

night.not_automated: Mild opening of blocked shadows near light sources; preference study only in v1.

backlit.subject_region: first face box if any, else the darkest 30% of L* in the original

landscape.note: spec.md section 1.1 has no landscape row. Reported, not gated. Owner decision needed before T1 eval-set freeze if landscape should be gated.

indoor_mixed.note: Stress class from the plan; no spec target. Reported, not gated.

class_rule_S1.image_pass: an image passes when every gated and applicable conditional criterion of its class passes, plus the skin criteria if it has faces
class_rule_S1.class_pass: class mean of every gated metric meets its target (absolute-valued metrics use the mean of absolute values) AND the share of images passing individually >= min_pass_rate
class_rule_S1.min_pass_rate_status: provisional in the plan; fixed here at G0 as 0.80, applied to the point estimate. CIs are reported, not gated.

exact.why: the percentile bootstrap degenerates to [p, p] when every image passes or fails; the exact interval stays honest at small n

already_good_rule_S2.automatic: class mean dE00 <= 3.0 on the already_good class (part of S1)
already_good_rule_S2.preference: non-inferior to Original in the preference study (95% CI lower bound of preference share >= 45%). Not automated here.

unscorable: An image whose class criterion cannot be computed (e.g. a portrait with no detected face, a sunset with no warm pixels) is listed as unscorable, excluded from pass rates, and counted. A frozen eval set must have zero unscorable images for the Original arm.

frozen_eval_set_requirements_G0.rights: every image has 'eval' in permitted_uses in the rights ledger
frozen_eval_set_requirements_G0.integrity: every file sha256 matches; manifest hash committed
frozen_eval_set_requirements_G0.leakage: no exact (sha256) or near (64-bit DCT pHash Hamming <= 6) duplicate between the frozen eval set and any train/validation manifest
frozen_eval_set_requirements_G0.source_tier: T1 only (own phone captures). Unsplash images (DEV-22) are never a frozen eval set and never train.

arms_policy.ai_auto: Only a model trained under auto-training-plan.md may be called AI Auto. Original (identity) and non-learned controls are never AI Auto.
arms_policy.research: FiveK-derived arms are internal evaluation only, never shown externally, never shipped, never used as training targets.
